title: MicroAge Elevates Industry Veteran Tracey Hayes to President
body_markdown:
November 20, 2026


**MicroAge Elevates Industry Veteran Tracey Hayes to President**


*Larry Gentry to retire following a tenure of leadership and contributions to the organization.*


**GREENVILLE, SC —**[ScanSource, Inc.](https://www.scansource.com/en) (NASDAQ: SCSC), a leading technology distributor uniquely positioned to address complex technologies, today announced the appointment of Tracey Hayes to president of MicroAge, effective January 1, 2027. As president, Hayes will be responsible for leading the organization’s strategic vision and supporting its long-term growth, ensuring the delivery of innovative cybersecurity, modern infrastructure, AI and cloud solutions, and managed services to MicroAge's clients.


Hayes began her career at MicroAge in 1993 as an account executive and has since served in a variety of leadership positions across the organization. Throughout her tenure, she has held roles spanning account development, product marketing, sales strategy, demand generation, and channel engagement, building deep expertise across the IT channel. Most recently, Hayes served as vice president of sales where she leveraged her expertise to help drive MicroAge’s sales-focused strategy, strengthen partner relationships, and accelerate organizational growth.


“Tracey’s deep understanding of MicroAge’s business, culture and its customers, combined with her proven track record of leadership, make her the ideal person to help guide MicroAge’s next chapter of growth,” said Mike Baur, Chairman and CEO, ScanSource, Inc. “Over the last three decades, she has made significant contributions across the organization, and I am confident she will lead MicroAge into future innovation.”


“I’m honored to step into this role. Having built my career with MicroAge, I have a deep appreciation for the talented team members and valued clients who have shaped who we are today. Together, we will continue delivering the IT solutions and services our clients depend on while building on the strong culture and values that define MicroAge as we look to the future,” said Hayes.


Hayes succeeds Larry Gentry, who will retire effective December 31, 2026. Gentry joined MicroAge in 2022 as part of the cStor acquisition. He was named Chief Executive Officer of MicroAge in 2025 and successfully led the organization through its acquisition by ScanSource, helping position the business for long-term growth while preserving its customer-focused culture and partner relationships.


“Larry’s impact on the company has been extraordinary. He’s helped shape culture, strengthen business and steer the company through pivotal moments including the acquisition by ScanSource. We’re grateful for his years of service and wish him all the best in retirement,” said Baur.


Hayes’ role is effective January 1, 2027, and she will report directly to Mike Baur. For more information about MicroAge, please visit


[www.microage.com](https://microage.com/) .


**About ScanSource, Inc.**
ScanSource, Inc. (NASDAQ: SCSC) is a leading technology distributor uniquely positioned to address complex technologies and to accelerate growth for channel sales partners across hardware, software as a service (SaaS), connectivity and cloud services. ScanSource uses multiple sales models to offer technology solutions from leading suppliers of specialty technologies, connectivity and cloud services.


On September 1, 2026, ScanSource completed the acquisition of MicroAge. MicroAge is


an award-winning full-service solutions integrator. For 50 years, MicroAge has empowered businesses to advance, secure, accelerate, and transform—moving quickly with technology changes across the channel to drive business forward. Our elite, highly certified team of specialized consultants brings unique expertise to our clients in cybersecurity, data intelligence, technology implementations, managed IT services, and more.


Founded in 1992 and headquartered in Greenville, South Carolina, ScanSource has been recognized as one of the Best Places to Work in South Carolina and on the Fortune World’s Most Admired Companies List. ScanSource ranks #923 on the Fortune 1000. For more information, visit


[www.scansource.com.](https://www.scansource.com./)
